meta.name: agent-team
meta.description: 产品经理与项目管理专家在应对复杂项目时，使用此技能可动态组建包含“执行、指挥、评审”的专属AI团队。实时查看多智能体辩论与决策全过程，共享统一上下文记忆，一键完成从会议决策到系统构建的全流程高效协同！

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 组建AI团队协同处理复杂项目，实时查看多智能体决策过程
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果你需要多智能体协助管理复杂项目、决策与执行。
copy.tagline_en: Build an AI team to handle complex projects, watch multi-agent decisions live
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need multi-agent assistance in managing complex, decision-heavy projects.

howto.what: 装上后 Claude 会按任务组建一支含执行、指挥、评审三类角色的智能体团队,完整展示它们讨论、辩论与决策的过程,共享同一份上下文记忆,最后把各方输出汇总成一个统一结果。
howto.when: 当你需要多个智能体协同完成任务,或需要管理特定场景的智能体组合时触发;也可以直接点名预设团队(如技术决策团队、OPC 团队等)来启动。

say.text: 请用技术决策团队评估一下微服务架构的可行性
say.note: 主持人、架构师、评审员会依次发言并辩论。

say.text: 请用OPC团队为AI短视频领域构建一套系统
say.note: 按战略分析、产品架构、自动化工程三步输出。

say.text: 请用产品团队为这款产品制定定价策略
say.note: 市场分析师、财务顾问、评审员依次给出意见。

howto.what_en: Once installed, Claude builds a task-specific AI team of executor, coordinator and reviewer roles, shows their discussion, debate and decision process, shares one context memory, and merges their outputs into a single result.
howto.when_en: Triggers when a task needs several agents working together, or when you need to manage a scenario-specific agent group; you can also name a preset team (e.g. tech decision team).

say_en.text: Use the tech decision team to assess a microservices architecture.
say_en.note: Host, architect and reviewers speak and debate in turn.

say_en.text: Use the OPC team to build a system for AI short videos.
say_en.note: Outputs go through strategy, product architecture, automation engineering.

say_en.text: Use the product team to set a pricing strategy for this product.
say_en.note: Market analyst, finance advisor and reviewer give input.
